title: Vegan Thanksgiving Potluck
seo_title: Vegan Thanksgiving Potluck in Springfield, MO
description: This is a 100% vegan Thanksgiving potluck where you can eat vegan versions of holiday classics and connect with fellow vegans and vegan-curious friends. Attendees are asked to bring a vegan dish to share, whether big or small, homemade or store-bought. It takes place Saturday, November 21, 2026 at 5:00 PM at The Library Center, 4653 S Campbell in Springfield, MO.
address: 4653 S Campbell, Springfield, MO, Springfield, MO
